variables.name: chosen
variables.notes: Species number picked on the menu (0 Furrbit, 1 Emberpup, 2 Splashell, 3 Voltail, 4 Sproutle, 5 Venomole, 6 Gustling, 7 Wispook, 8 Pebbulk). Kept between runs.

variables.name: xp_pct
variables.notes: Progress to the next level, 0-100 (the XP bar).

variables.name: g1
variables.notes: Move 1's charge gauge (0 locked, 1-5 empty to full, 6 flash).

variables.name: run_over
variables.notes: Set when the run is won or lost (stops the timer).
